description: This command refines an existing element in the range by subdividing it into i equal-size segments. The original structural element is deleted.
verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/common/sel/doc/manual/sel_manual/cables/commands/cmd_structure.cable.refine.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
